title: Richmond City Public Schools Policies
description: Learn about Richmond City Public Schools policies and leaders.
body:
# Richmond City Public Schools Policies

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/richmond-logo.jpg)

- 2025 State performance **[indicators](https://web.archive.org/web/20260222112853/https:/schoolquality.virginia.gov/divisions/richmond-city-public-schools)** show 30 of Richmond’s 40 schools are either “off-track” or “needs intensive support.”
- In 2024-25 only 53% of students passed reading proficiency tests, compared to 74% state-wide. Only 44% passed writing performance, compared to 76% state-wide. Only 49% passed Math proficiency, compared to 72% state-wide.

- Policies (in section 8) **[require school staff](https://go.boarddocs.com/vsba/richmond/Board.nsf/Public?open&id=policies)** to use a name and gender pronoun that reflects a student’s chosen gender identity without notification or permission from parents.
- Activities, including athletics not governed by the VHSL, **[shall permit](https://go.boarddocs.com/vsba/richmond/Board.nsf/Public?open&id=policies)** students to participated based on gender identity not biological sex (section 8 of school board policies).
- Access to locker rooms and bathrooms **[are based](https://go.boarddocs.com/vsba/richmond/Board.nsf/Public?open&id=policies)** on a student’s gender identity, not biological sex (section 8 of school board policies).
